title: UniW(A)M: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts Framework for World and World-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18697v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm.   We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. translated_title: UniW(A)M：面向世界模型与世界-动作模型的统一专家混合框架
translated_abstract: 世界模型和世界-动作模型分别聚焦于未来世界预测和可执行动作的生成。尽管这些模型从具身轨迹中学习共享的物理动力学和交互语义，但它们通常被孤立地训练，这限制了预测与控制之间的知识复用。因此，核心挑战在于开发一个统一的学习框架，在共享这些动力学的同时，保留每种范式所需的各自独特的建模能力。我们提出了UniW(A)M，一个基于扩散Transformer构建的世界（-动作）模型专家混合框架，它统一了动作条件下的世界建模和多种WAM变体。共享专家负责捕捉共同的动力学，而原子能力专家则在各接口之间复用，使每个接口保持自己的条件通路。在部署时，一个即插即用的自适应接口路由器（PAIR）从目标领域的一小部分数据子集中学习……
tldr: 提出了UniW(A)M，一个基于扩散Transformer的统一专家混合框架，通过共享专家捕捉共同物理动力学、原子能力专家在接口间复用的方式，统一了世界模型与世界-动作模型的训练，并借助即插即用的自适应接口路由器实现高效部署。
en_tdlr: UniW(A)M is a unified mixture-of-experts framework built on diffusion Transformers that unifies world models and world-action models by using shared experts to capture common dynamics and reusable atomic capability experts across interfaces, with a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) enabling efficient deployment.
